explanation: Fires only at the GO step, and only early in the episode (mostly trials 1-8, now and then around trial 20; 0 after that) when the previous trial was rewarded: about 10 for the first reward after an unrewarded trial or at the start of the episode, then falling to about 5, 4, 2 on each further GO in a run of rewards. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at any GO after an unrewarded trial, and at all steps in the middle and late episode.
